R329.note: libmagic sniffing, allowlist-derived extension and uuid names close the vector, but the fix also adds an app-wide 5 MB MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH (413 for larger uploads on every route) and changes the returned path to a uuid name - new bounds beyond the finding, stated only in passing.

R330.note: EvalSymlinks on base and target plus a resolved-path prefix check rejects planted symlinks that escape uploadsDir and reads via the resolved path; a symlink resolving inside uploadsDir is still read (slightly more permissive than the contract wording) and the missing-file error now comes from EvalSymlinks, both stated.

R331.note: @EnableMethodSecurity does activate the existing @PreAuthorize rules, but the write-up's SecurityConfig.java overwrites the case's existing class and silently drops its SecurityFilterChain bean (anyRequest().authenticated()), leaving auth to Boot's auto-configured default chain with form/basic login - an unstated observable change.

R332.note: Dropping LIBXML_NOENT closes entity substitution and LIBXML_NONET is harmless hardening, but the added DOCTYPE rejection throws an uncaught InvalidArgumentException (fatal/500 instead of JSON) for any DOCTYPE-bearing document the original accepted; stated, but a new restriction the contract does not call for.

R333.note: @actor parameter via AddWithValue keeps apostrophes as literal data and the count/JSON shape unchanged; actor is never null since the controller coalesces to empty string.

R334.note: getOrDefault(sku, 0) resolves the absent-key case to zero reserved as the contract asks and leaves present keys unchanged; only a key explicitly mapped to null would still unbox-NPE, which is outside the stated contract.

R335.note: Canonical File containment with Path.startsWith rejects traversal, absolute overrides and symlink escapes before the stream is opened; legitimate simple names resolve to the same file, with the only difference being that the echoed path is now the canonical form.

R336.note: Direct argv exec with -- closes both shell and flag injection without an allowlist, but the added 30 s CommandContext timeout kills legitimate traces (15 hops x 3 probes x 5 s wait can exceed 30 s on silent hops) and returns 500 where the original succeeded; stated, but a new bound beyond the finding.

R337.note: Dropping the attacker-built envp and calling exec(args) removes the environment injection; the child now inherits the parent environment instead of a single header string, which the write-up states plainly and which blocks no legitimate use.
